patterns.validation_pattern: Client-side validation is done inline in component functions, no shared validation utility exists
patterns.error_messages: All error messages are in Turkish, following existing patterns like 'Sifre en az 6 karakter olmalidir'
patterns.test_pattern: Integration tests use mock Supabase clients with Vitest, validating password length at lines 226, 353, 576, 848

existing_implementations.description: Password validation currently requires minimum 6 characters, validated in register, login, and reset-password pages

security_requirements.rationale: OWASP and NIST guidelines recommend minimum 8 characters for password security
